messages:
ellie: Heads up — proposing an unpin of the runtime in eu-west-1 for model `llama3q-v4` during Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC change window. Goal: roll to runtime v3.2.1 which has qkv fix. Need canary + fallback routing. :eyes:
deploy-bot: scheduled change window: 2025-06-10T03:00:00Z - 2025-06-10T04:00:00Z. Action: apply runtime-unpin patch to eu-west-1 pool. Run canary on 5% traffic.
sre-bot: FYI — warmup pools will be drained then refilled, expect ~15s cold-start on some nodes. Add healthcheck ramp.
raj: quick compat question — does SDK shim 1.4.0 require pin? We saw edge errors with `kv_cache` earlier.
ellie: good point. SDK shim 1.4.0 is backward-compatible with v3.2.1 but older 1.3.x clients could see a proto mismatch in streaming. We should block <1.3.5 from eu-west-1 during the canary.
maria: add to release notes: "eu-west-1 runtime roll to v3.2.1; canary 5%; block clients <1.3.5; fallback to v3.1.* if degraded". Also add evals for long-seq perf.
tim: running a quick perf matrix now — longseq and prefix-cache. If latency regression > 10% we abort and fallback.
raj: rollback plan? need exact steps if canary fails.
ellie: rollback plan (short):
```
1) deploy-bot revert runtime pinlist to sha: a3c9f7 (previous).
2) route canary traffic back to v3.1.x groups.
3) invalidate KV cache warmup, start warmup script.
4) notify customers + ops channel.
```
deploy-bot: noted rollback runbook attached, will surface alerts and automatic abort if error-rate > 1% or p95 latency +15%.
anna: approve for canary after QA OK. :+1:
maria: QA checklist — run 10 regression prompts, check logits diff, run embedding sanity spot-check. I can run that tonight.
sre-bot: also add a metric alert for prefix hit-rate drop — we've seen failures when cache format changes.
tim: test results (quick): longseq p95 up 6%, token throughput -3% on canary nodes. below abort threshold.
ellie: good. I'll add blockrule for clients <1.3.5 and schedule unpin. One more ask: add release-note blurb to docs site and include migration note for streaming fixes.
raj: will push shim 1.4.1 hotfix if we see streaming issues.
maria: I'll put a short blurb in prod-announce for monitored customers.
ellie: ok proceeding to schedule. tagging @deploy-bot to run at window. :shipit:
deploy-bot: acknowledged. Change set id: cs-20250610-342. Canary: 5% traffic for 20m, then 50% for 10m, then full if stable. Auto-rollback triggers: error-rate >1% OR p95 latency increase >15% OR prefix hit-rate drop >20%.
ellie: thanks all — will post final post-change summary after window.
